svg.title: 01 Soft Amber full workflow editor preview
svg.desc: Static illustrated application UI with sample data. The Daily report workflow includes navigation, variables, resources, a step table, selected and focused rows, code with selected characters, run progress, a properties inspector, form controls, validation feedback, and an open action menu. Colors follow the 01 Soft Amber guide. The illustrated controls do not operate.
svg.text: Build and review the morning summary.
5 steps / 1 warning / validate the recipient to publish.
